title: The Adventures of Jimmie Dale
author: Frank L. (Frank Lucius) Packard
description: "The Adventures of Jimmie Dale" by Frank L.
longDescription: Packard is a novel likely written in the early 20th century. The story introduces Jimmie Dale, a wealthy gentleman and a graduate of Harvard, who also operates as the masked criminal known as the Gray Seal.

authorInfo.bio: Frank L. (Frank Lucius) Packard (1877–1942) is the author of The Adventures of Jimmie Dale. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
